topic.title: Weather, Climate, and Geospatial Learning
topic.area: Continuous Models and Scientific Machine Learning
topic.overview: These papers model phenomena that vary across space and time, using weather records, satellite imagery, and other geographic data. Forecasting horizons, spatial resolution, and available modalities shape the learning problem. Shared datasets and software are central because inconsistent processing can make apparently similar model comparisons misleading.
topic.whyItMatters: Useful forecasts inform resource allocation and adaptation, but quality must be measured against appropriate physical and operational baselines. Flexible spatial representations also help when different regions have different kinds of observations.
topic.evolution: The collection includes 1990s spatial interpolation and rainfall modeling, followed by storm imagery resources and coordinated weather benchmarks. Recent work introduces foundation models and multimodal geographic representations that can operate with missing modalities. These examples show increasing emphasis on reusable infrastructure and transfer across locations, without making regional forecasting equivalent to urban indicator prediction.
openQuestions: How should evaluation measure performance under genuinely unfamiliar climate conditions?
Which physical constraints remain reliable when combining heterogeneous spatial observations?

papers.title: SIFusion: A Unified Fusion Framework for Multi-granularity Arctic Sea Ice Forecasting
papers.tldr: SIFusion combines sea-ice information across temporal granularities to improve forecasts by exploiting relationships between short- and long-term behavior.

papers.title: SmokeViz: A Large-Scale Satellite Dataset for Wildfire Smoke Detection and Segmentation
papers.tldr: SmokeViz aligns expert smoke annotations with representative satellite images, producing a public dataset with more than 160,000 manual annotations.

papers.title: TreeFinder: A US-Scale Benchmark Dataset for Individual Tree Mortality Monitoring Using High-Resolution Aerial Imagery
papers.tldr: TreeFinder supplies high-resolution, pixel-labeled aerial imagery and benchmarks for individual-tree mortality mapping across 48 states.

papers.title: Visualizing Our Changing Earth: A Creative AI Framework for Democratizing Environmental Storytelling Through Satellite Imagery
papers.tldr: EarthCanvas combines satellite reconstruction with language-guided storytelling, reporting strong reconstruction and a 40% improvement in user comprehension and engagement.

papers.title: ClimateAR: Multi-Scale Autoregressive Generative Modeling for Climate Forecasting
papers.tldr: ClimateAR combines simulation-to-observation alignment with multi-scale conditioning to improve probabilistic seasonal-to-interannual climate forecasts.

papers.title: Dywave: Event-Aligned Dynamic Tokenization for Heterogeneous IoT Sensing Signals
papers.tldr: Dywave aligns sensor tokens with temporal events, improving reported accuracy while substantially shortening input sequences.

papers.title: EMFormer: Efficient Multi-Scale Transformer for Accumulative Context Weather Forecasting
papers.tldr: EMFormer combines efficient multiscale features, accumulative-context fine-tuning, and dynamically weighted losses to improve long-term weather forecasts.

papers.title: Hyperspectral Image Fusion with Spectral-Band and Fusion-Scale Agnosticism
papers.tldr: SSA combines flexible spectral-band processing with continuous spatial reconstruction to support one fusion model across scales and adaptable sensor settings.

papers.title: LangPrecip: Language-Aware Multimodal Precipitation Nowcasting
papers.tldr: LangPrecip combines radar observations, language descriptions of motion, and a consistency-focused decoder to improve short-term rainfall forecasts.

papers.title: Localized, High-resolution Geographic Representations with Slepian Functions
papers.tldr: Slepian-based location encoders concentrate geographic detail in a target region and outperform tested alternatives across five prediction tasks.

papers.title: Multi-Scale Wavelet Transformers for Operator Learning of Dynamical Systems
papers.tldr: Multi-scale wavelet transformers preserve fine-scale frequency information to improve dynamical-system forecasts and reduce climate prediction bias.

papers.title: PODiff: Latent Diffusion in Proper Orthogonal Decomposition Space for Scientific Super-Resolution
papers.tldr: PODiff performs scientific super-resolution in orthogonal, variance-ordered coefficients, preserving accuracy with lower cost and useful uncertainty estimates.

papers.title: Residual-Guided Multi-Resolution Refinement of Foundation Models: A Case Study in Drought Forecasting
papers.tldr: RGMR improves drought forecasts by applying residual-guided, coarse-to-fine refinement to frozen time-series foundation models.

papers.title: Scaling Laws of Global Weather Models
papers.tldr: Empirical weather-model scaling favors more training data and wider architectures, with distinct trade-offs between parameter efficiency and hardware utilization.

papers.title: SENDAI: A Hierarchical Sparse-measurement, EfficieNt Data AssImilation Framework
papers.tldr: SENDAI combines simulation priors with learned corrections to reconstruct structured spatial fields from extremely sparse observations.

papers.title: (Sparse) Attention to the Details: Preserving Spectral Fidelity in ML-based Weather Forecasting Models
papers.tldr: Mosaic combines ensemble perturbations and block-sparse attention to preserve weather forecasts' spectral structure without compressive encoding.

papers.title: StormInsight: Hierarchical Environmental Forcing and Vertical Coupling for Convective Systems Evolution
papers.tldr: StormInsight predicts three-dimensional storm evolution using environmental conditions and vertical interactions, improving results on the new StormBench benchmark.

papers.title: Transforming Weather Data from Pixel to Latent Space
papers.tldr: WLA unifies and compresses weather data into latent space, reducing ERA5 storage substantially while improving evaluated downstream results.

papers.title: U-Cast: A Surprisingly Simple and Efficient Frontier Probabilistic AI Weather Forecaster
papers.tldr: U-Cast combines a standard U-Net with staged training to deliver competitive probabilistic weather forecasts at substantially lower computational cost.

papers.title: UrbanFusion: Stochastic Multimodal Fusion for Contrastive Learning of Robust Spatial Representations
papers.tldr: UrbanFusion combines flexible subsets of geospatial modalities into spatial representations that generalize across urban tasks and unseen regions.

papers.title: WeatherSyn: An Instruction Tuning MLLM For Weather Forecasting Report Generation
papers.tldr: WeatherSyn uses specialized instruction tuning to generate weather reports, outperforming leading closed-source models on the authors' dataset.

papers.title: WIND: Weather Inverse Diffusion for Zero-Shot Atmospheric Modeling
papers.tldr: WIND combines a pretrained atmospheric video diffusion model with inverse-problem solving to handle varied weather and climate tasks without task-specific fine-tuning.
